premise: Excavator builds the seedling a house of dust, then of pebbles, then of moon-brick — but there's no wind on the Moon to blow any down, and what the seedling needs is light: the greenhouse.
inspiration: The Three Little Pigs, turned: the danger was never the wind — there isn't any — and the brick house becomes a garage.
lesson: Give someone what they need, not just what you're good at making.

en-US.title: Three Little Domes
en-US.text: The {seedling:enter} seedling needed a proper home. {excavator:enter} [excited] Leave it to me! rumbled Excavator. {excavator:live} It dug up moon dust and piled it into a little dome. {robot:enter} {robot:face surprised} But the wind will blow it down! said Robot. [laughs] {excavator:shake} There's no wind on the Moon, said Excavator. {excavator:pulse} Still, it built a stronger dome from pebbles, and then the strongest of all, from moon dust pressed into bricks. {canvas:dust 5s} Dust flew. Bricks stacked. [pause] {seedling:wobble} But the seedling drooped. Walls weren't what it needed. {robot:face happy} {robot:hop} I know! said Robot. It needs light, and air, and warmth. {greenhouse:enter} Across the plain, the greenhouse {greenhouse:live} switched on its grow-lights. So they set the seedling's pod inside, and {seedling:live} it reached up into the violet light. {robot:face surprised} And the brick house? {excavator:sparkle} Excavator kept that. [giggles] Every digger needs a garage.

es-ES.title: Tres cúpulas
es-ES.text: El {seedling:enter} brote necesitaba una casa como es debido. {excavator:enter} [excited] ¡Déjamelo a mí! retumbó Excavadora. {excavator:live} Sacó polvo lunar y lo amontonó en una cupulita. {robot:enter} {robot:face surprised} ¡Pero el viento la va a tirar! dijo Robot. [laughs] {excavator:shake} En la Luna no hay viento, dijo Excavadora. {excavator:pulse} Aun así, hizo una cúpula más fuerte, de piedrecitas, y luego la más fuerte de todas, con ladrillos de polvo lunar prensado. {canvas:dust 5s} Volaba el polvo. Se apilaban los ladrillos. [pause] {seedling:wobble} Pero el brote estaba mustio. No necesitaba paredes. {robot:face happy} {robot:hop} ¡Ya sé! dijo Robot. Necesita luz, y aire, y calorcito. {greenhouse:enter} Al otro lado de la {greenhouse:live} llanura, el invernadero encendió sus luces de cultivo. Así que pusieron la maceta del brote dentro, y {seedling:live} se estiró hacia la luz violeta. {robot:face surprised} ¿Y la casa de ladrillo? {excavator:sparkle} Esa se la quedó Excavadora. [giggles] Toda excavadora necesita un garaje.
